name: BrdComplianceAgent
description: Joins requirement traceability's criterion verdicts with the Pass/Fail Engine's runtime tests into a requirement → criterion → evidence → verdict matrix, flags code-vs-runtime discrepancies (implemented but broken at runtime, works but not found in code, inconsistent runtime results, runtime-only criteria never reached) and measures the evidence mix (E5/E4 runtime vs E3/E2 code); compliance scoring (v1.1) uses the discrepancies and runtime counts for gates and recommendations.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Traced requirements with criteria, priority, origin, verifiability, verdict, score

inputs.name: pass_fail
inputs.description: Runtime verdicts per criterion and test with artifact links

outputs.name: brd_compliance
outputs.description: matrix[{requirement, criteria[{verdict, strength, credit, basis, static, runtime{verdict, strength, mixed, tests[]}, discrepancy}]}], discrepancies[{kind, severity, detail, criterion_code, requirement_code}], evidence_mix{by_strength, runtime_share, credit_by_basis}, counts
